title: GOSt-MT: A Knowledge Graph for Occupation-related Gender Biases in Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a Knowledge Graph (GOSt-MT) to compare real-world labor market gender statistics with gender representation in textual datasets used for Machine Translation (MT) training. The methodology uses an LLM pipeline alongside dependency parsing and coreference resolution to extract occupations from text, link them to the Knowledge Graph, and identify their associated genders.
